class LightFeed.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Model

Represents a news story submitted to a publisher by an assigned journalist. Requires review and validation from an assigned editor before going live. The approved flag tracks editorial sign-off, and created_at records when the story was first filed.

LightFeed.tests module

class LightFeed.tests.LightFeedAPITestSuite(methodName='runTest')[source]

Bases: APITestCase

Automated test engine validating role-based authorization parameters, isolated subscription filters, newsletter storage integrity, and Option 2 post-approval background webhook delivery automation pipelines.

setUp()[source]

Set up standardized, role-isolated test configurations and database entities.

test_approval_workflow_triggers_automations(mock_send_mail, mock_requests_post)[source]

SUCCESS CASE: View execution runs mail blasts and X webhook posts.

test_editor_can_update_article_attributes()[source]

SUCCESS CASE: System editors hold universal oversight capabilities.

test_journalist_can_create_article()[source]

SUCCESS CASE: Journalist uploads content, defaulting fields to draft.

test_journalist_can_publish_independently()[source]

SUCCESS CASE: Journalist submits an article with no publisher assigned at all, confirming independent publishing works end to end through the API (not just the model layer).

test_newsletter_integrity_constraints()[source]

SUCCESS CASE: Assures newsletter models map properties cleanly.

test_reader_cannot_create_article()[source]

FAIL CASE: Assures regular accounts cannot inject stories into the directory.

test_reader_retrieve_all_published_only()[source]

SUCCESS CASE: Assures readers can only view live approved publications.

test_reader_subscribed_feed_isolation()[source]

SUCCESS CASE: Readers isolate streams matching their followed sources.

test_subscribed_feed_includes_followed_journalists_independent_work()[source]

SUCCESS CASE: Following a journalist (not a publisher) should still surface that journalist’s independently-published articles, confirming the independent-publishing and follow features work together correctly.

test_unauthenticated_access_fails()[source]

FAIL CASE: Assures traffic without credentials receives an HTTP 401 response.

LightFeed.urls module

LightFeed.views module

LightFeed.views.add_article(request)[source]

Allows assigned journalists to draft and submit news articles. Verifies that the journalist is explicitly assigned to the selected publisher.

LightFeed.views.add_newsletter(request)[source]

Enables assigned journalists to compose new newsletter bulletins for authorization, by selecting from their publisher’s approved articles to compile into a curated digest.

LightFeed.views.approve_newsletter(request, newsletter_id)[source]

Allows an assigned editor to verify and dispatch a pending newsletter bulletin.

LightFeed.views.articles_hub(request)[source]

Group landing page for article links (Editors and Journalists).

LightFeed.views.build_email(user, reset_url)[source]

Create the email the user sees to reset the email.

LightFeed.views.change_user_password(request, username, new_password)[source]

Change user password safely

LightFeed.views.create_publisher(request)[source]

Allows authorized platform Editors to register a new media network outlet. Safely handles the Many-to-Many relationship mapping for assigned editors.

LightFeed.views.delete_article_page(request, article_id)[source]

Enforces authorization security policies to delete a specific article record. Allows Editors to remove any story, and Journalists to delete only their own. Redirects back to the main management dashboard layout with clean alert feedback.

LightFeed.views.delete_newsletter(request, newsletter_id)[source]

Enforces authorization security policies to delete a specific newsletter record. Allows Editors to remove any bulletin under their publishers, and Journalists to delete only their own.

LightFeed.views.delete_publisher(request, pub_id)[source]

Safely deletes a publisher profile and its associated dependencies. Verifies that the logged-in Editor is explicitly assigned to this publisher.

LightFeed.views.edit_article_detail(request, article_id)[source]

Preloads existing article fields inside form inputs for editing. Allows platform-wide Editors to modify any article, and Journalists to modify only their own authored stories.

LightFeed.views.edit_newsletter(request, newsletter_id)[source]

Preloads existing newsletter fields inside form inputs for editing. Allows assigned Editors to modify any newsletter under their publishers, and Journalists to modify only their own filed bulletins.

LightFeed.views.edit_publisher(request, pub_id)[source]

Allows an assigned editor to update their publication’s name or description. Utilizes plural ManyToMany lookups to verify assigned workspace permissions.

LightFeed.views.generate_reset_url(user)[source]

Creates the reset url.

LightFeed.views.login_user(request)[source]

Logs in user

LightFeed.views.logout_user(request)[source]

Logs out user.

LightFeed.views.manage_articles(request)[source]

Displays a list of articles for editing/deletion based on role permissions

LightFeed.views.manage_newsletters(request)[source]

Centralized controller workspace engine for managing custom corporate newsletters. Allows journalists to see filed copies and enables editors to authorize dispatches.

LightFeed.views.manage_publishers(request)[source]

Displays a list of publisher channels managed by the logged-in Editor. Utilizes plural ManyToMany lookups to verify operational role assignments.

LightFeed.views.news_feed_hub(request)[source]

Group landing page for reader-facing news feed links.

LightFeed.views.newsletters_hub(request)[source]

Group landing page for newsletter links (Editors and Journalists).

LightFeed.views.publish_draft(request, article_id)[source]

Allows an authorized platform Editor to change a draft’s status to published. Automates outbound subscription email blasts and triggers external X network tweets.

LightFeed.views.published_newsletters(request)[source]

Public-facing feed of approved/dispatched newsletter bulletins, mirroring view_articles but for newsletters.

LightFeed.views.publishers_hub(request)[source]

Group landing page for publisher management links (Editors).

LightFeed.views.toggle_subscription(request, target_type, target_id)[source]

Allows a Reader to follow/unfollow a Publisher or a Journalist. Acts as a toggle: following an already-followed target unfollows it.

LightFeed.views.view_articles(request)[source]

Fetches article datasets dynamically based on operational role permissions. Editors see all logs (approved/unapproved); Readers/Journalists see live data.

LightFeed.views.view_journalists(request)[source]

Fetches all journalist profiles from database to display

LightFeed.views.view_publishers(request)[source]

Fetches all publishers from database to display

LightFeed.views.welcome_page(request)[source]

Shows the welcome page.
